text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pergigian (Pengecualian Tempoh

Perkhidmatan Awam) 2014.

Pengecualian

2. Menteri memberikan pengecualian penuh kepada orang yang dinamakan dalam

Jadual daripada menjalani tempoh perkhidmatan awam yang dikehendaki di bawah

seksyen 48 Akta.

JADUAL

1. Dr. Ahmad M. Daood

2. Dr. Resha Adnan Malik

3. Dr. Laith Mahmoud Abdul Hadi

4. Dr. Yap Tsen Wei

Dibuat 8 Oktober 2014

[KKM-60(20/2)/1/5; PN(PU2)93/VI]

DATUK SERI DR. S. SUBRAMANIAM

Menteri Kesihatan

DENTAL ACT 1971

DENTAL (PUBLIC SERVICE EXEMPTION) ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 49(1)(a) of the Dental Act 1971

[Act 51], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Dental (Exemption of Public Service Period)

Order 2014.

Exemption

2. The Minister grants a complete exemption to the persons named in the Schedule

from undergoing the period of public service required under section 48 of the Act.

SCHEDULE

1. Dr. Ahmad M. Daood

2. Dr. Resha Adnan Malik

3. Dr. Laith Mahmoud Abdul Hadi

4. Dr. Yap Tsen Wei

Made 8 October 2014

[KKM-60(20/2)/1/5; PN(PU2)93/VI]

DATUK SERI DR. S. SUBRAMANIAM

Minister of Health
